market.question: Will the highest temperature in Houston be between 80-81°F on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Houston Hobby May 3 forecast: highs in mid-70s to ~78-82°F across sources. The 80-81°F bucket overlaps the median forecast. Sources differ (one mid-70s, others 78 and 82) so true central tendency near 78-80; bucket captures realized max with moderate but not high probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Post-frontal air mass moderation could leave max in upper 70s instead of 80-81 bucket.
